column1: # Host chitinase and chitin metabolism genes in Manouria impressa genome (GWHHIVU00000000.1)
# !! SUPERSEDED IN PART - this is the 2026-04 annotation-only search, kept as the record of what
# !! the annotation contained. Two conclusions in the NOTES below were WITHDRAWN after the genome
# !! itself was searched (tBLASTn/miniprot): the locus holds EIGHT loci / NINE complete GH18 genes,
# !! not three, and CHIA-clade orthologs ARE present. See tables/25 (full-length BLAST
# !! verification), tables/32 (the genome-level locus map) and tables/45 (Mimp_v3 chromosome 4
# !! coordinates). Coordinates here are the earlier assembly release; the manuscript uses Mimp_v3.
# SECTION 1: CHITINASE-RELATED GENES (BLAST hits - ab initio predicted, unannotated)
# These genes were identified by BLASTP against known chitinase sequences.
# They lack functional annotation in the GFF (ab initio Augustus predictions).
# These three ANNOTATED models are clustered on chromosome 3 (GWHHIVU00000003.1) of the earlier
# release = chromosome 4 of Mimp_v3. The cluster holds five further loci that this annotation-only
# search could not see (tables/32); the expansion is real but larger than three genes.
# - No annotated CHIA, CHIT1, CHI3L1, CHI3L2, HEXA, HEXB, CTBS, or CHID1
#   genes were found in the GFF annotation.
# - Three unannotated ab initio genes on chr3 (12.4-12.6 Mb) show significant
#   sequence similarity to chitinase-3-like protein 1 (CHI3L1/YKL-40) and
# - WITHDRAWN: "the cluster may represent chitinase-like proteins (CLPs)". Of the eight loci now
#   known, seven carry an intact DxDxE catalytic motif and four (L4-L7) nest inside the amniote
#   CHIA clade; only 088393 is an inactive CLP (tables/32, results/phylogeny/v2).
# - WITHDRAWN: "CHIT1 had 0 BLAST hits, suggesting it may be absent". The queries were truncated.
#   Full-length queries hit at E = 0.0 (tables/25). Testudines DO possess CHIA orthologs; CHIT1
#   orthology for 088392 remains unresolved. Absence was never demonstrated.
